lane.scope_note: Controlled generic Traditional-script bridge only; no Taiwan, Hong Kong, or Macao localization.

concept.preferred_gloss: controlled non-localized Traditional Chinese script/register rendering
concept.intended_sense: A separately compiled Hant rendering of the source-reconciled zh-Hans-CN text, retaining the same mathematical sense while making no regional prose claim.
excluded_senses: automatic evidence transfer from Simplified Chinese

target.audience: mathematically trained reader requiring Traditional characters

candidates.form: OpenCC s2t plus controlled 為/群/裡/個/眾/才 normalization

script_forms.Hant: 為 / 群 / 裡 / 個 / 眾 / 才

candidates.definition_or_gloss: generic controlled Hant artifact without regional localization
requires separate Hong Kong or Macao terminology/prose review

support.context_window: Exact source unit controls formulas, author hierarchy, footnotes, emphasis, and all mathematical distinctions in both Chinese scripts.

weight_semantics.notes: Source authority cannot by itself authorize a Hant term form.

candidate.context_window: The complete audited Hans unit is converted character-wise, then diff-checked for formulas, TeX commands, and controlled Hant forms.

weight_semantics.notes: A Hans source can seed a script candidate but cannot serve as independent Hant usage evidence.

adverse.observed_form: Mandarin Simplified evidence cannot fill Traditional Chinese regional channels
adverse.context_window: The dominance rule explicitly prohibits cross-filling Hant regional support from Mandarin Simplified evidence.

weight_semantics.notes: Hard qualitative control; not a readiness score.

absence.search_scope: Paper 29 native shelf and lane records
absence.notes: No Taiwan-specific mathematical prose or reviewer return.

absence.search_scope: Paper 29 native shelf and lane records
absence.notes: No Hong Kong-specific mathematical prose or reviewer return.

absence.search_scope: Paper 29 native shelf and lane records
absence.notes: No Macao-specific mathematical prose or reviewer return.

sense.notes: Mathematical sense is controlled by the audited Hans unit and sealed German source.

false_friend.notes: Character conversion can preserve a misleading Hans lexical choice; term-level decisions remain separate.

homograph.notes: Shared Han forms do not prove identical regional usage or register.

dominance.notes: The script artifact is derived from Mandarin Simplified prose and has no independent Hant regional source. No numeric penalty is computed.

register.notes: Generic Hant mathematical prose may diverge from Taiwan, Hong Kong, or Macao preferences.

script.notes: OpenCC s2t plus explicit 為/群/裡/個/眾/才 normalization; output was separately compiled and rendered.

source_scarcity.notes: No independent Hant Paper 29 source or regional reviewer return.

source_floor.evidence_or_reason: Sealed German source and a fully audited Hans base exist.

context_review.evidence_or_reason: All eight source units and script/math invariants are checked internally.

adverse_review.evidence_or_reason: Mandarin dominance and non-localization limits are explicit.

branch_or_cohort_review.evidence_or_reason: Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macao cohorts are absent.

script_policy.evidence_or_reason: Artifact is labelled controlled generic zh-Hant, not regional.

internal_qa.evidence_or_reason: Hans/Hant contain 124 ordered math spans with identical canonical sequences; each has 3 primed sums, 2 g(y,d y) loci, and 5 numbered displays; both compile twice to four pages and every page was inspected.

decision.rationale: A separately labelled, compiled generic Hant rendering improves script access while preserving strict non-localization and dominance-debt boundaries.
decision.reviewer_question: Which terminology and prose changes are required separately for Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macao standards?
decision.decision_authority: Chinese Noether production lane internal script and source audit

invariants.must_preserve: all formulas, symbols, fields, and source-aligned footnote loci
invariants.may_change: Chinese character forms and later locale-specific prose
invariants.test: TeX-aware Hans/Hant diff plus source-unit map

provenance.notes: Controlled non-localized Hant only. Basin and qualitative dominance debt remain in the crosswalk; no regional or external certification is claimed.
